titolo: Google acquires Crusoe’s unfinished Wyoming AI data center project
descr: Google buys Crusoe’s pre‑developed Wyoming site and plans a $17 billion campus, while Crusoe continues other AI‑focused data centers.
paragrafi: Denver‑based Crusoe announced that Google has purchased its unfinished data center site in southeast Wyoming.
The transaction completes Crusoe’s pre‑development work, which covered site selection, government approvals and a hybrid power plan with Tallgrass Energy.
Google did not reveal the purchase price but said it will invest $17 billion to build a data center campus on the site.
Crusoe, valued at $30.9 billion, remains a partner for Google’s new data center near Amarillo, Texas, and continues building AI‑focused facilities for Oracle, OpenAI, Microsoft and Meta.
The sale follows Crusoe’s recent $3.9 billion funding round and its strategy of leasing space for customers’ GPUs, renting its own GPUs and selling AI inference compute.
perche: For AI developers, Google’s investment may speed up access to large‑scale, energy‑efficient compute resources. For users of free or locally hosted models, the deal underscores the growing reliance on hyperscaler‑backed infrastructure, highlighting why independent providers like Crusoe focus on flexible leasing and inference services.
